answer: Locks are recorded in vine, expire in echo, and jetty lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 18 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A hostile operator running 72 aliases hence needs 64 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3806 identities would post 844 proofs and burn roughly 61 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
